---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Michael L. Wilson <michael...@peercorpstrust.org>
Date: Mon, Apr 29, 2013 at 3:15 PM
Subject: [R-jobs] R consultant/biostatistician sought for short term project
To: R-sig...@r-project.org


We are looking for a capable biostatistician or epidemiologist with
sufficient exposure and knowledge of R in order to translate a series
of legacy code into R compatible syntax files and perform statistical
analyses on an as needed basis.

Responsibilities:
-- Translation of legacy syntax from Stata .do files into reproducible
R compatible syntax files.
-- Perform other statistical analyses as required.

Ideal Candidate has the following Skills and Experience:

Required
-- Proficiency in advanced R programming, analyses (trends; Poisson,
logistic, linear regression) and knowledge of graphical functions
-- Skills in dataset manipulation (40,000+ cases)

Preferred
-- Proficiency using a Linux-based operating system
-- Proficiency using Libre/OpenOffice suite of desktop applications
-- Possess at least a relevant graduate degree (statistics,
mathematics, etc.) OR demonstrate proficiency using R

Please reply with CV (in PDF format only) to i...@peercorpstrust.org

(NB! Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted).
